cohort: 576 mothers of infants aged less than six months in Samara-Logia city administration, Afar Regional State, Ethiopia
finding: Nearly eight in ten infants aged less than six months achieved low/medium BPI scores, with maternal age older than 34 years, infant age of 4-5 months, home or caesarean delivery, and lack of advice on proper infant feeding practices associated with higher odds of low/medium BPI scores.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with higher odds of low/medium BPI scores in infants.
